fields.statement: Close-out and the model-PR merge update the main checkout with git fetch origin main followed by git merge --ff-only refs/remotes/origin/main, through one shared helper, and never with git pull, so a concurrent fetch rewriting FETCH_HEAD and the user's pull.rebase or pull.ff settings cannot fail the update. Only the git commands change: the step is still refused when main is not on main or has tracked changes, and a failure is still recorded as main-stale.
fields.wording: the planner's design from its research, in an autonomous plan run with no owner present

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShip|TestModelPR' passes, with: (1) the close-out unit tests in internal/api/ship_test.go (the fakes now answering git fetch origin main and git merge --ff-only refs/remotes/origin/main in place of git pull --ff-only origin main) asserting that a successful close-out runs that fetch and that merge in the main checkout, runs no git command whose first argument is pull, and reports update-main done; (2) (failure case) a close-out whose git merge --ff-only refs/remotes/origin/main fails reports update-main failed, main_updated false, a detail starting 'main was not updated: ' with git's error, and records main-stale; (3) (failure case) a close-out whose git fetch origin main fails does the same and runs no merge; (4) a test in internal/api/model_prs_test.go where a model PR merges asserts the main checkout is updated by the same fetch and merge, with no git pull, and (failure case) a failing merge records main-stale. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(ship-close-out-forget-retry|ship-close-out-log-copies)' passes, and grep -rn '"pull"' internal/api/*.go | grep -v _test.go prints nothing.
fields.must_not: Change when the update is refused (shipMainBlocked) or what dropIncomingLogCopies drops; change the main-stale record, the update-main step's name or results, or the ShipCloseOutResponse JSON shape; rebase, reset or force main; retry in a loop; touch the worktree fetches in ship.go, ship_rebase.go or watchdog_noci.go, or the daemon self-update.
fields.statement: ship close-out and pullMainAfterModelMerge fast-forward the main checkout through one helper that runs git fetch origin main and then git merge --ff-only refs/remotes/origin/main, never git pull, so FETCH_HEAD written by a concurrent fetch and a global pull.rebase=true no longer fail the update.
